stories.title: Rescuers pull survivors from flooded Nepal tunnel as glacier-collapse toll nears 1,300
stories.summary: Rescue teams in Nepal's Rasuwa district reached survivors trapped in a Trishuli-3A hydropower tunnel after flash flooding, pulling two out alive as one was found dead. A tunnelling expert says a 'Goldilocks zone' may hold more survivors, in a disaster that has killed nearly 1,300.

stories.title: U.S. conflict with Iran enters 7th month; Vance says I wouldn't call this a war
stories.summary: As the U.S.-Iran conflict reaches seven months, Vice President JD Vance played down the label of war and said Washington will investigate a recent missile strike while doubting U.S. involvement. The remarks come amid sharp escalation fears after strikes exchanged in the Gulf.

stories.title: Israel's national security minister outlines plan to expel all Palestinians from Gaza Strip
stories.summary: Israel's National Security Minister has publicly laid out a plan calling for the expulsion of all Palestinians from the Gaza Strip. The proposal drew immediate criticism from rights groups and raised alarm about a further escalation of Israel's campaign in the enclave.

stories.title: U.N. warns the world will overshoot 1.5C global heating limit
stories.summary: The United Nations warned that the world is on track to overshoot the 1.5C Paris Agreement limit on global heating, in a new assessment published Friday. The report sharpens pressure on governments ahead of upcoming climate talks.

stories.title: Which tools do Claude, Codex and Cursor choose? Study measures 17,000 agent runs
stories.summary: A new analysis of more than 17,000 coding-agent runs measures which developer tools Claude, Codex and Cursor actually reach for. The data gives engineers a look at agent tool habits as AI coding assistants become standard workflow.

stories.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra
stories.summary: OpenAI has launched GPT-6 Astra, its next frontier model generation. The release, topping Hacker News, signals another step in frontier-model competition as OpenAI pushes multimodal and agentic capabilities.

stories.title: Qwen 3.8 27B available on Cerebras at 1,500 tokens per second
stories.summary: The Qwen 3.8 27B model is now served on Cerebras hardware at roughly 1,500 tokens per second inference. The deployment highlights how optimized inference hardware is making large open-weight models dramatically faster for developers.

stories.title: K2 Horizon: connected fleet of six open models released
stories.summary: Ifm.ai released K2 Horizon, a connected fleet of six open models designed to work together across capabilities. The open release adds another option for teams building multi-model AI systems without vendor lock-in.

stories.title: Browns urged to pair Deshaun Watson with 6-foot-8 target, but they shouldn't, says Sporting News
stories.summary: With Deshaun Watson confirmed as Cleveland's Week 1 starter, pundits are debating whether the Browns should add a 6-foot-8 deep threat for him - a move The Sporting News argues against. The analysis lands as the roster waits to see how Watson's comeback season looks.

stories.title: Browns QB Shedeur Sanders turns heads with surprise trip
stories.summary: Browns rookie quarterback Shedeur Sanders made a surprise off-field appearance that turned heads, remaining Cleveland's primary backup behind Deshaun Watson with Taylen Green third on the depth chart. The move adds to the ongoing QB storyline as the season approaches.

stories.title: Chris Simms makes eye-opening claim about Browns' QB competition aftermath
stories.summary: Analyst Chris Simms weighed in with a notable take on Cleveland's Deshaun Watson-vs-Shedeur Sanders quarterback decision, months after the competition dominated offseason headlines. His comments predict how the situation could play out if Watson struggles.

stories.title: Browns still hunting defensive line help, work out five linemen
stories.summary: Cleveland general manager Andrew Berry brought in five linemen for workouts Thursday as the team keeps reshaping the roster ahead of Week 1. The tryouts signal continuing churn along the line after late-August roster cuts.

stories.title: Ohio State among 8 schools selected for federal manufacturing program
stories.summary: Ohio State was chosen as one of eight universities for a new federal manufacturing program, opening up research and workforce opportunities. The award lands as the university's engineering and materials programs expand.

stories.title: Here's your game day guide for Saturday's traffic at Ohio Stadium
stories.summary: A game day guide outlines road closures and traffic expectations around Ohio Stadium for Saturday's season opener against Ball State, with more than 100,000 people expected in the area. Fans heading to the 12:30 p.m. kickoff are advised to plan routes and arrive early.

stories.title: What to know before you hit the road to the Buckeyes season opener
stories.summary: 10TV previews road and pathway conditions ahead of Ohio State's season opener, warning that more than 100,000 fans around Ohio Stadium will make campus traffic hectic. The guide covers timing and alternate routes for gameday.

stories.title: Ball State Game Trailer: LeBron James narrates, Metallica soundtrack
stories.summary: Ohio State released its season-opening game trailer Thursday night, narrated by LeBron James with a Metallica soundtrack ahead of Saturday's Ball State game. The video sets the tone for a No. 1-ranked Buckeyes squad making its 2026 debut.

stories.title: Leclerc leads Ferrari one-two in opening Monza practice with new engine
stories.summary: Charles Leclerc topped first practice at the Italian Grand Prix with a 1:23.008 lap, 0.173s ahead of teammate Lewis Hamilton in a Ferrari one-two as the team debuted its engine upgrade at Monza. Mercedes' George Russell slotted in behind the Ferraris.

stories.title: FIA: Leclerc leads Ferrari one-two in opening practice at Monza
stories.summary: In front of the tifosi, Leclerc produced a late-session benchmark of 1:23.008 to finish 0.173 seconds clear of Hamilton, with George Russell best of the rest for Mercedes. The session marked Ferrari's strong start to its home weekend.

stories.title: F1 Italian GP: Leclerc heads Ferrari 1-2 in opening practice
stories.summary: Leclerc's 1m23.008s on medium tyres edged teammate Lewis Hamilton on a hot summer afternoon at Monza. Ferrari's early pace sets up an intriguing qualifying session as the Italian GP weekend begins.

stories.title: Italian GP: Leclerc leads Hamilton as Ferrari seal one-two in first practice
stories.summary: Ferrari impressed in Italian Grand Prix first practice, with Charles Leclerc leading Lewis Hamilton in a one-two after debuting an engine upgrade at Monza. The red cars' pace puts them in front heading into the rest of the weekend.

stories.title: Tarkov Arena 0.6.0 to add new Tactical Map: Laboratory
stories.summary: Battlestate Games teased the upcoming Escape from Tarkov: Arena 0.6.0 update, which brings a new three-floor Tactical Map named Laboratory with 56 unique rewards and hidden easter eggs. The studio also asked players which new challenges they want to see in the mode.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov announces GearUP network-routing collaboration
stories.summary: Battlestate Games announced a collaboration with GearUP designed to minimize packet loss and connection spikes in Escape from Tarkov via dedicated network routing. It is the most recent official main-game announcement amid an otherwise quiet news stretch.

stories.title: Twitch Drops live for Kord Breach season one launch
stories.summary: Escape from Tarkov kicked off Twitch Drops to celebrate the launch of season one, the new Kord Breach season. Players can earn drops while watching streams as the long-awaited first season begins.

stories.title: Patch 1.1.0.0 releases with Kord Breach PvP season
stories.summary: Escape from Tarkov patch 1.1.0.0 introduced the new Kord Breach PvP season, along with a Seasons hub and a modifier build calculator. It remains the latest main-game patch ahead of the expected winter wipe cycle.

stories.title: Ex-Columbus police officer pleads guilty in 2022 Donovan Lewis shooting
stories.summary: A former Columbus police officer pleaded guilty to reckless homicide in the 2022 fatal shooting of unarmed Donovan Lewis. The plea opens the way for sentencing in one of central Ohio's most closely watched police-involved cases.

stories.title: 911 service interruptions affecting Columbus area, AT&T reports
stories.summary: AT&T reported outages in Franklin County that could affect customers calling 911 or the police non-emergency line in the Columbus area. Officials are urging residents to seek alternate contact routes while the disruption persists.

stories.title: Intel CEO under pressure to resign from Trump and Sen. Moreno
stories.summary: Intel's CEO faces growing calls to step down from President Trump and Ohio Senator Bernie Moreno, per NBC4's 'Intel in Ohio' coverage. The pressure adds uncertainty for the company's sprawling central-Ohio fab investments.

stories.title: Invasive insect sightings on the rise in central Ohio
stories.summary: Reports of invasive insects are increasing across central Ohio, prompting officials to ask residents to document sightings. The uptick could threaten native trees and agriculture in the Columbus area.
